html:
Add decimals using place value

Decimals name parts of the same whole. Align decimal points so that thousandths are added to thousandths, hundredths to hundredths, and ones to ones.

Trailing zeros do not change a number: 2.26 and 2.260 have equal value. Exchange ten units in any column for one unit in the column to its left. Keep the exact value unless the question asks for rounding.

A method to try

  1. Write the numbers with decimal points in one column. Add trailing zeros when helpful.
  2. Add from the smallest place. Regroup ten of one unit as one of the next larger unit.
  3. Place the decimal point in line with the original decimal points.

Worked examples

5.300 + 2.251

Think of 5300 thousandths plus 2251 thousandths. Their sum is 7551 thousandths.

5.300 + 2.251 = 7.551

Check: 7.551 − 2.251 = 5.300.

A mistake to watch for

Do not line up only the rightmost digits: 2.3 means 2.300, not 0.023.

Check and explain

Estimate the whole-number size and subtract one addend from the sum.
